bce3e28c-fbf9-459c-b32e-588d04f60331.title: Train Coupler
bce3e28c-fbf9-459c-b32e-588d04f60331.description:
Link train cars without welding them into a single creation.

How to use:
Place a coupler on each car and bring them close together. Press [E] to couple or uncouple.

Logic connections:
Input: A pulse toggles the connection.
Output: Active while coupled.
